label: Dub Audio
description: Dub a recording into another language: translated and re-voiced to match the original speakers. Runs as long as the dub takes and emits the dubbed audio file.

inputs.name: account
inputs.description: The ElevenLabs access (wire an ElevenLabsAccess node).

inputs.name: file
inputs.description: The audio or video to dub.

inputs.name: targetLang
inputs.label: Target language
inputs.description: ISO language code to dub into (fr, es, de, ...).

inputs.name: sourceLang
inputs.label: Source language
inputs.description: ISO code of the spoken language. Absent = auto-detect.

inputs.name: numSpeakers
inputs.description: How many speakers the recording has. Absent or 0 = auto-detect.

inputs.name: dropBackgroundAudio
inputs.label: Drop background audio
inputs.description: Keep only the dubbed voices, discarding music and effects.

outputs.name: dubbingId
outputs.description: The dub project's id on the account (re-download other languages, or delete it).
